description: Golden corpus for the deterministic quality gates. Every case is a content sample with a known correct verdict. Any change to a gate script, banned-word list, or overclaim pattern must keep this corpus passing — and should add a case proving the change. Runner: python scripts/quality_gates/golden_check.py

cases.why: Specific, numeric, jargon-free local-business content must not be flagged.
Dense Tier 1 jargon and AI slop must hard-block.
Keyword in H1, answer-first structure, no AI-search overclaims: zero hard errors.
Guaranteed ChatGPT citations and llms.txt-as-ranking-factor claims must hard-error.
